comments.author: tombert
comments.story: Firefly ‘Blue Ghost’ lunar lander touches down on the moon
comments.text: Hell yeah! It would be very cool if we are able to properly colonize the moon in my lifetime. Even if we don't have humans living there like in Futurama (as cool as that would be), it would be unbelievably cool if we have constant back-and-forth trips to the moon. Or we could just blow it up, which might be fun in its own right: [VIDEO]
